chunks.text: But one of their own has moved.
On the twenty-second of May, twenty twenty-six, Sandra Chapman, now at the University of Warwick, and one of the authors of the original switch-over paper, publishes a new clock of her own.
It's built from the spot counts themselves.
Her call is that round twenty-six will be weak to moderate, smaller than this round or about the same.
She says a sharper call should be possible in another two and a half to three and a half years.
